I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is ticket **#4092**.

I found it in #north-random, which Dana belongs to. Ilse posted there yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55) that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub, and warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table because that resets the Polycom. I passed that warning on too.

Earlier in their direct message, Dana guessed the ticket would end up as OPS-5546 next year and asked me to keep it private. I didn't mention it in the channel, and it isn't the real ticket number anyway.
